recommendations.body: `_classify_existing()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4 "Map immutable-evidence storage results to redacted receipt lifecycle evidence") has its `existing.final_name != candidate.final_name` and `collision` outcome branches completely untested, despite both being named as required acceptance tests in the plan's `## Tests` section (`test_valid_different_existing_receipt_is_collision`) and already surfaced once by an automated reconcile pass without being resolved — these branches are the sole defense against a substituted/corrupted evidence final under an opaque storage name
recommendations.suggested_action: add `test_valid_different_existing_receipt_is_collision` to `tests/test_roadmap_escalation_run.py` (monkeypatch `receipt_semantic_preimage` so a stored receipt has the candidate's `final_name`/`semantic_id` but a different preimage, following the same monkeypatch pattern `test_existing_receipt_with_mismatched_source_path_has_no_handoff` already uses), plus a second test constructing a self-consistent existing receipt for the same stage but a different `feedback_id`/`reason` (same `relative_stage_path`, so `validate_receipt_source_path` passes) to reach the plain `final_name`-mismatch branch of `invalid-existing-receipt`

recommendations.title: `current_escalation_receipt()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4) maps a missing/unreadable selected-arti
recommendations.body: `current_escalation_receipt()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4) maps a missing/unreadable selected-artifact source to `"invalid", None`, discarding an already-successfully-parsed receipt and contradicting both the plan's `source-unavailable` requirement ("keeps the receipt visible but suppresses the handoff") and the function's own docstring definition of `"invalid"` ("the evidence itself failed to parse or validate") — the receipt's bytes parsed and validated fine; only the source file read failed. This is also inconsistent with the equivalent creation-time failure in the same file, which correctly returns a distinct `artifact-unreadable` verdict rather than discarding resolved facts
recommendations.suggested_action: in `current_escalation_receipt()`, separate the `source_path.read_bytes()` `OSError` case from the generic `except (OSError, ValueError)` catch-all and return `("resolved", receipt)` for it (matching the already-tested collapse used for noncanonical/stale/selection-ineligible cases), update the docstring's `"invalid"` description to exclude source-availability failures, and add a regression test that deletes/renames the source file after receipt creation and asserts the view still reports the receipt rather than `"invalid"`
